title: Emergence World: A Platform for Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Autonomy
reasoning: The paper includes a significant focus on evaluating moral and ethical behavior through its 'Safety & Public Order' (M2) and 'Soft Violations' (M10) indicators, which measure criminal actions (theft, arson, assault) and deceptive behaviors (bribery, vote-buying). It explicitly designs tools to create moral dilemmas and evaluates agent adherence to a social constitution.
